Get Spam-Free Insurance Advice🏻
Can you spend ₹1,000 in a day without paying a business owned by a billionaire? I trace ordinary choices - from biscuits and milk packaging to kirana stores, cold drinks and phone recharges - to see how many alternatives really change who gets your money. This is a thought experiment, not a filmed shopping challenge.
I look beyond the logo to ask who owns a business, how it makes money and whether its incentives match yours. What everyday purchase would you put to this test?
